Arundhati Roy once pirated her own 1989 film, In Which Annie Gives It Those Ones, for a bookshop owner who loved quoting its dialogues. Directed by Pradip Krishen, the Doordarshan television film quietly disappeared after its late-night telecast. Starring Roy and featuring Shah Rukh Khan in an early screen appearance, the film captured the language, humour and rebellious spirit of college life.
